verdict_rationale: TX TDLR (Texas Department of Licensing and Regulation) is a Texas state government agency. HVAC/AC contractor and technician licenses are mandatory public disclosures under Texas Government Code §552 (Public Information Act). TDLR publishes all license records as a public bulk download on data.texas.gov with no access restrictions. Data fields: business name, license type, license number, business address, phone, expiration date — standard regulatory public fields. No SSNs, DOB, financial accounts. Individual AC technicians are licensed professionals — their regulatory info is public record (same as NPPES NPI for healthcare providers). PASS.

pii_check.notes: Business address and phone from government license record. AC technicians are licensed professionals — regulatory public disclosure.
